test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SHIMLA' is written as 'TJLQQG' and 'RANCHI' is written as 'SCQGMO'. How will 'MUMBAI' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/616ccb35eefb2543c40dda4244355f9c011600e87cf71fb011948cbc33406795.png] 

'SHIMLA' is written as 'TJLQQG'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a843b66505eb9da31d94244bd8d780c22a11e684bddbb6c23960283ed0c7680.png] 

and

'RANCHI' is written as 'SCQGMO'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9378dbe27500078cd808bc9a4aee0b985aa4e63e74b51c4e02b68da7a5d0bdbe.png] 

Similarly,

'MUMBAI' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94eb5a71106970a20eba84d85a3d5d250901b2605b60e927a382524b891f7387.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "NWPFFO".**
